news.headline: NeurAxis Completes Stock Option-for-RSU Exchange, Discloses New Executive Grants
news.summary: Converted 1,319,394 outstanding options into RSUs 1-for-1 (effective July 24); new executive and director RSU grants approved Aug 13, vesting over three years.

news.headline: NRXS Stock Dips Post Q2 Earnings Despite Revenue Surge
news.summary: Shares fell 8-9% despite revenue +116% YoY, as the $1.93M print landed slightly below thin analyst consensus estimates.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Revenue Up 116% Year Over Year
news.summary: Q2 revenue $1.9M, IB-Stim deliveries +60%, ASP +28% to $992/device; cash of $8.3M at quarter-end after raising $2.5M via ATM and warrant redemptions.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Mid-Atlantic Policies
news.summary: New medical policy coverage for PENFS/IB-Stim covering 500,000+ lives in the Mid-Atlantic region.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Prior-year Q3 call was held Nov 11, 2025; management gave no specific Q3 2026 date on the Aug 11 call. Would extend the streak of consecutive quarters of double-digit YoY revenue growth.

catalysts.label: Continued payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Adding regional insurer medical policies for PENFS/IB-Stim; latest addition Aug 4 covered 500,000+ Mid-Atlantic lives.

catalysts.label: Category I CPT code ramp
catalysts.detail: Full-year benefit of the Jan 1, 2026 CPT code assignment driving reimbursement gains and ASP growth.

catalysts.label: RED (Rectal Expulsion Device) commercialization progress
catalysts.detail: Second product line (FDA-cleared, Category I CPT-coded) adoption updates for chronic constipation testing.

catalysts.label: VA Federal Supply Schedule rollout
catalysts.detail: IB-Stim listed on VA FSS contract (effective Dec 2025) opening access to the ~7M-patient veterans health system; adoption pace still emerging.

pulse: As of 2026-08-26, no NeurAxis-specific news has broken since the Aug 19 8-K on the option-to-RSU exchange and executive RSU grants. The stock remains in a post-earnings lull after the Aug 11 Q2 print showed headline-strong 116% YoY revenue growth ($1.9M) and rising ASP, but shares sold off ~8-9% as the absolute dollar figure missed thin analyst expectations. Near-term catalysts are incremental (payer-coverage additions, CPT-code-driven reimbursement ramp) rather than binary, with the next major event likely the Q3 2026 report around November.
